accepted_lessons.name: name_factor_intervention_by_operational_level
accepted_lessons.requirement: Keep a centered partial output-factor swap, a mass-compensated partial coefficient swap, a complete attention-pattern swap, a realizable query/key-state swap, and literal native remove-and-insert as distinct interventions. A result may claim only the operational level actually executed.

builder_prompt_addendum: For every attention-factor counterfactual, state whether it changes a projected output factor, selected coefficients with or without mass compensation, the full attention pattern, or a realizable query/key state. Report whether the modified coefficients obey the native pattern's total-mass constraint and whether any query/key state is known to realize them. Retain a separate literal-removal or complete-state test for sufficiency and selective removal.
critic_prompt_addendum: Plant a normalized three-source attention pattern where replacing only the two registered coefficients changes total mass, and plant a native-versus-factorized contraction discrepancy. Reject any claim that the centered partial output-factor arm is automatically a full attention-score swap, a realizable query/key counterfactual, literal native removal, or compiled sufficiency.
